The following events occurred in '''995 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] makes his first attempt to create his own [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]], but fails.<ref name="rot">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]'' - Chapter 10 states that Bane's second attempt was "several months" after his first attempt. So depending in what part of the year 995 BBY his first attempt was, his second attempt may have been in either 995 BBY or 994 BBY.</ref>
